spans.s:
रेख रेख, अस्, m. (fr. रिख् = rt. लिख्), a
line, &c. (= रेखा below); a proper N.; (आ). f. a
line; a streak, stripe; a row, series [cf. लेखा];
a continuous line; drawing; the first or prime me-
ridian (considered to be a line drawn from Laṅkā
to Meru, i. e. from Ceylon supposed to lie on the
equator to the North-pole); = आभोग, fulness, satis-
faction; = छद्मन्, deceit, fraud; a small quantity,
little portion; [cf. probably Old Germ. riga.]
—रे-
खांश (˚खा-अं˚), अस्, m. a degree of longitude.
—रेखाकार (˚खा-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, formed in
lines, striped.
—रेखा-गणित, अम्, n. ‘line-reckon-
ing,’ geometry.
—रेखान्तर (˚खा-अन्˚), अम्, n.
geographical longitude, distance east or west from
the first meridian, (see रेखा above.)
—रेखा-न्यास,
अस्, m. the marking down of lines or lineaments.

रेखाय, Nom. A. रेखायते, &c., to praise,
flatter; to vex, distress, annoy.

रेखिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having lines (on the hand &c.),
lined.
